name: Drover's Dog
notes: Belongs to nobody in particular and to whichever string of animals is going the right way. It attaches itself at one camp and detaches at another, which over a season carries it further than any of the people it walked with. The drovers do not feed it and would notice at once if it were not there.
journal_prompt: It has been forty paces ahead since the ford and has not once looked back to check you are still coming, which is either trust or indifference and is probably both.
